name: BSS 1.0
summary: BSS 1.0 is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price consolidation ranges and enters trades when price breaks out of the established range. It uses a systematic approach to detect range boundaries and execute trades in the direction of the breakout, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: BSS 1.0是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，它识别价格盘整区间并在价格突破已确立的区间时入场交易。该EA使用系统化方法检测区间边界，并在突破方向执行交易，具有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: BSS 1.0的核心策略概念是价格突破盘整区间后跟随趋势方向入场。入场条件为价格突破前期确立的支撑或阻力区间边界，向上突破则做多，向下突破则做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，也可能包含追踪止损机制来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数或基于账户余额动态计算仓位大小。资金管理上，EA通过止损设置控制单笔交易的最大风险敞口，但具体的资金管理策略取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合在波动性增加的市况中捕捉趋势启动行情，但在窄幅震荡市中可能产生频繁的假突破信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of BSS 1.0 is entering trades in the direction of price breakouts from consolidation ranges. Entry conditions are triggered when price breaks above a defined resistance boundary for buy signals or below a support boundary for sell signals. Exit conditions rely on pre-configured stop loss and take profit levels, and may include a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing can be configured with a fixed lot size or dynamically calculated based on account balance and risk parameters. Money management is implemented through stop loss placement to control maximum risk exposure per trade, though the effectiveness depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-suited for capturing trend initiation during increasing volatility, but may generate frequent false breakout signals in narrow ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，突破交易是经过验证的趋势捕捉方法
包含点差过滤机制，避免在高点差环境下入场
止损和止盈设置可配置，风险可控
追踪止损功能可以锁定浮动利润
魔术号码区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clear strategy logic - breakout trading is a proven trend capture method
Includes spread filter to avoid entering during high spread conditions
Configurable stop loss and take profit for controllable risk
Trailing stop feature locks in floating profits
Magic number distinguishes orders, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
cons: 盘整区间识别可能不够精确，容易产生假突破信号
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一周期突破可靠性有限
没有新增K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
固定参数难以适应不同市场环境，缺乏自适应机制
缺少交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利入场
cons_en: Range identification may lack precision, prone to false breakout signals
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single timeframe breakout reliability is limited
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Fixed parameters struggle to adapt to different market conditions, lacks self-adaptation
Missing trading session filter, may enter during low liquidity periods
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，提高突破信号可靠性
添加自适应参数调整，根据市场波动性动态优化区间周期和缓冲设置
实现新增K线检查，防止在同一K线上重复开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve breakout signal reliability
Implement adaptive parameter adjustment to dynamically optimize range period and buffer based on market volatility
Implement new bar check to prevent duplicate position openings on the same candle

risk_points: 假突破可能导致频繁止损，连续亏损风险
缺少新增K线检查可能导致信号重复触发
固定止损可能无法适应所有市场波动环境
risk_points_en: False breakouts may cause frequent stop losses and consecutive loss risk
Missing new bar check may cause signal duplication
Fixed stop loss may not adapt to all market volatility environments
